hero.heading: Dream of Becoming a Doctor?
hero.description: India has one MBBS seat for every ten NEET-qualified students. Studying MBBS abroad at universities that follow the NMC FMGL Gazette 2021 provides students with a proven path to their dream of becoming a doctor, and we have helped 18,500+ students make that dream a reality since 2009.
